fuse.clearing_note: The specified opening points are retained as source facts. Neither interpolation nor extrapolation to variable-current faults, temperature corners or total DC clearing is established. Nominal melting I2t omits arcing and is not an upper bound.

remaining_evidence: Independently supported passive source-voltage/current envelope and non-fuse loop resistance minima over charge, temperature and tolerances; no use of cell pulse label, maximum wire DCR or nominal fuse resistance as a lower bound.
Maximum total DC clearing time or waveform across the entire prospective-current range, ambient and L/R; include arcing, not nominal melting I2t or average time-current curves.

Peak and total I2t withstand of cell, both contacts/interfaces, switch, both conductors, copper/vias and solder terminations at their actual temperatures; continuous current ratings do not supply these.
Insulated pre-fuse terminal geometry and faults bypassing F1 require prevention/containment; F1 cannot interrupt a current that never passes through it.
Charged-rail capacitance, initial voltage, discharge-loop ESR/resistance and coupling; passive RC assumptions exclude active converters, USB ingress and inductive stored energy.
Extend the bounded subset to every load/sense/return branch and reversal state after the full circuit is defined. Current-limited or resistive faults may persist without opening F1.
